note: group measurement is the closest of the five atlas groups (randomness and counting); the page is cell biology

title.zh: 减数分裂与配子多样性

description.zh: 减数分裂两次分裂、随机取向给出 2ⁿ 种配子、交换与重组率，并与有丝分裂对比；每对最多一次交换的教学模型。
description.en: The two meiotic divisions, random alignment giving 2ⁿ gametes, crossing over and recombination frequency, compared with mitosis, in a teaching model with at most one crossover per pair.

reason.zh: 每对染色体独立地随机取向，n 对的组合数是 2ⁿ，配子的分布由计数得到。
reason.en: Each pair aligns independently at random, so n pairs give 2ⁿ combinations and the gamete distribution follows from counting.

label.en: Tallying random draws to see a distribution

reason.zh: 页面反复随机做减数分裂并累积计数，次数越多各种配子的比例越接近期望，与蒙特卡洛同一思路。
reason.en: The page repeatedly runs random meioses and tallies them; the more draws, the closer the shares are to expectation, the Monte Carlo idea.

title.zh: 为什么同一对父母的孩子都不一样？
title.en: Why are children of the same parents all different?

ask.zh: 减数分裂两次分裂、染色体随机取向——n 对染色体能组合出几种配子？
ask.en: Meiosis divides twice with random chromosome alignment — how many gamete combinations do n pairs give?

ask.zh: 交换让同源染色体互换片段——交换后，配子的组合数是变多还是变少？
ask.en: Crossing over swaps segments between homologous chromosomes — does that raise or lower the number of gamete combinations?

ask.zh: 如果随机模拟很多次受精，孩子完全相同的概率有多大？
ask.en: Simulating many random fertilisations, how likely are two children to come out identical?

reveal.zh: 随机取向给出 2ⁿ 种配子，交换又添新组合，两个配子随机结合，孩子几乎不可能完全相同。
reveal.en: Random alignment gives 2ⁿ gametes, crossing over adds more combinations, and two random gametes combining make identical children vanishingly unlikely.
